info.title: Kost Hospitality — implemented foundation API
info.description: Development only; subset of baseline. All mutations require exact Origin; authenticated mutations additionally X-CSRF-Token. Session idle 30m, absolute 12h.

post.description: Owner-only foundation documents. Domain proof/identity ownership authorization not yet integrated. Always quarantine; max 10 MiB; sniffed MIME.
Owner-only; external ClamAV unavailable => 503 and stays quarantined.

200.description: Authenticated proxy stream; clean files only; no-store, attachment, nosniff.

post.description: Token 5m/single-use bound to actor+session+action+organization+target. Staff actions require organizationId; scope/revoke additionally targetId. MFA actions target authenticated user and do not accept organizationId. Enabled MFA requires valid unused TOTP or recovery code.

Session cookie may be pending MFA. Challenge belongs to this user+session, expires and allows five failed attempts. Successful login challenge rotates cookie/CSRF; enrollment returns recovery codes only once.

get.description: Active Owner only; projected tenant data, cursor pagination.
Active Owner only; projected tenant data, cursor pagination.

post.description: Verified active Owner; Owner scope must be empty/all locations; other roles require at least one property in this organization. Invitation expires 72h. Email token is never returned.
Authenticated verified email must match invitation. Existing staff membership is not required. Same idempotency key replays result; new key cannot reuse a consumed token.
Active Owner and scoped reauth required; last Owner cannot be demoted. reauthToken excluded from idempotency payload hash.
Last Owner protected by database; next tenant request denied after revocation while other organizations remain available.

202.description: New 24h verification token queued if unverified; old verify tokens invalidated. Limit 3 per 15min.
